name: Mariner
overview: The Scriptures portray mariners as those who venture into the vast and often perilous seas, witnessing firsthand the mighty works and wonders of the LORD in the depths. As they face stormy winds and towering waves that cause their souls to melt with trouble, their experience reflects human frailty and dependence on God. In their distress, when they stagger like a drunken man and reach the limits of their own wisdom, they cry out to the LORD, who faithfully delivers them from danger and brings them safely through their trials.
